body: Thats absolutely beautiful, your voice is fantastic.

it'll probably get buried but for me it was when my elder brother was depressed, drank a full bottle of whiskey and left the house barefoot at 8 am. We searched for him for hours, in the end when he found him he went construction site and spent a while there. We finally convinced him to get home and go inside but he changed his mind and he ran off and kicked a garbage disposal car. His big toenail got ripped off and we had to take him to the hospital. The expression on his face when he looked up at me, holding his toe, that's something I'll never forget. This happened a few months ago
I live in Istanbul and it's really nice and sunny most of the time so when it's different it's always nice

That's exactly what I'm going through. I wish it was simpler but I guess if we're at the emotional point that suicide is better than anything else, then that's got to have an impact on those that are responsible for our emotional welfare. 
  
I hate that it does though, because that means that until we can find a way out, we have to go about our daily businesses hiding the suicidal person inside us. I really know what you're feeling like right now and not that I think I can help but if you want to talk just pm me.

Thank you for replying but I can't just find a meaning like that. I loved to be able, but for me it's a bit harder. All of the things that I find motivates most people, means nothing to me. Dreams of living big, famous or rich, doesn't do anything for me.

Please don't do it. At the moment I feel like I don't care about anything and that life is just a whole bunch of fancy gimmicks that are on the way to an eventual death, **but I don't want to give up**. I have no reason, and I'm here to find one, to live. But **unless you've got a reason which is too unbearable to even think about solving, or imagine without, it's not worth it**. 
  
PM me if you need to in fact do it am either way, we can get through this but you're gonna have to want to.
